message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.bear: Something heavy is crashing through the brush toward you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.lion: Tawny shapes are slinking through the grass. You're being stalked.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.tiger: Something striped is watching you from the undergrowth.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.alligat: Something low and scaled slides out of the reeds toward you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.komodo_: A forked tongue flicks. Something has caught your scent.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.rhino: The ground shakes. Something big is about to charge.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.desert_: Pincers click in the sand around you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.jungle_: Pincers click in the leaf litter around you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.boar: Tusked shapes are grunting and coming your way.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.snake: A rattle, or a hiss? Something is coiled close by.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.feral_w: A howl, then another, closer. The pack has your scent.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.coyote: Yips and cackles in the dark, all around you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.tarantu: Something hairy is scuttling over the ground toward you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.moose: A bellow, and the crack of antlers on wood. Something big doesn't want you here.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.werewol: A howl, far too close, and then the snap of branches. Something on two legs is running on four.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.ogre: The ground shakes. Something huge is lumbering your way, and it has seen you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.cave_og: Stones rattle down the slope. A grey shape the size of a hut is climbing toward you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.fire_og: A smell of brimstone on the wind, and a red glow coming over the rise.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.wraith: The air goes cold. Something pale is drifting toward you, through whatever is in its way.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.flame_w: A flicker of flame where nothing burns, and it is coming closer.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.silver_: A rattle of bones and the ring of steel. Pale shapes are running at you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.mud_gol: The mud heaves up and stands. It has your scent.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.notus_d: A shadow crosses the sun and the air smells of cinders. Notus, the south wind, has seen you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.boreas_: The wind drops and your breath hangs in the air. Something long and pale is gliding overhead. Boreas, the north wind, has seen you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.zephyru: The frogs go quiet. Something under the water is watching you. Zephyrus, the west wind, has seen you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.wild_bo: Tusked shapes are grunting and coming your way.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.minotau: Hoofbeats on stone, and a bellow off the rocks. Something with horns is coming down the mountain.
